About Me

Design with a purpose.

A Visual Designer who loves turning ideas into experiences.

I'm Chandirakkumar, a Visual Designer focused on creating learning experiences that make a real difference. I enjoy bringing together visual design, user experience, eLearning, and multimedia technology.

From an interactive Storyline module to a polished presentation or motion graphic, my goal is simple: make information easier to understand and more engaging to experience.

Learning First Design that supports understanding.
Visual Thinking Clean and purposeful visual design.
Multimedia Video, animation and interaction.
Impact Experiences built around outcomes.

My Process

From ideas to impact.

A simple process that keeps learning goals, visual design, development, and outcomes aligned.

01

Understand

Understand the audience, learning need, content, and desired outcome.

02

Design

Shape the content into an engaging visual and learning experience.

03

Develop

Build interactions, visuals, animations, assessments, and multimedia.

04

Deliver

Review, refine, publish, and deliver a polished learning experience.

Why I Do This

Because learning changes people.

I believe well-designed learning can build skills, create opportunities, and make information easier to understand. That's what keeps me motivated to create better experiences.

Let's Create Impact
Learn Make knowledge easier to understand.
Grow Turn learning into meaningful progress.
Perform Connect learning with real outcomes.
Succeed Create experiences with measurable value.
